    AI Overview
    Rick Pitino is the head men's basketball coach at St. John's University, hired on March 20, 2023, as the 22nd coach in program history. A Hall of Fame coach, Pitino revitalized the team in his third season (2025-26), leading them to a 30-6 record, a Top-25 ranking, and a 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 appearance. 
    Key Details About Rick Pitino at St. John's: 
    • Background: He is a two-time NCAA National Champion (Kentucky 1996, Louisville 2013) and a 2013 Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame inductee.
    • 2025-26 Season: Pitino led the Red Storm to a 30-6 record and the Sweet 16.
    • Coaching Staff: The staff includes Associate Head Coach Steve Masiello.
    • Reputation: Known for turning programs around quickly and for his intense, high-energy coaching style. 
    For more detailed information, you can view the official Rick Pitino - Men's Basketball Coach - St. John's Athletics bio, the full 2025-26 Men's Basketball Coaching Staff - St. John's Athletics, and a list of St. John's (NY) Men's Basketball Coaches on Sports-Reference.com. You can also read about his coaching success in this USA Today article.
